title: The Utility of Serum Tryptase in the Diagnosis of Shrimp- Induced Anaphylaxis
brief_summary: The purpose of this study was to investigate the utility of serum tryptase for the confirmation of shrimp-induced anaphylaxis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* a history of shrimp allergy

Exclusion Criteria:

* severe anaphylactic reaction from seafood
* pregnancy
* underlying diseases such as cardiovascular, hepatobiliary, and renal diseases
* on systemic corticosteroid or β-blocking agents
